_comment: FROST Server (OGC SensorThings API) via APISIX Gateway proxy on the public API host. Owner: Team 2
_api_host_comment: DEV-ONLY default (issue #1368). In staging/production this MUST be overlaid via Helm/Kustomize to the environment-specific API host (e.g. api.core.example.org). Shipping the default to prod makes the host guard in frost_server.rego fall through and FROST unreachable.
